title: A 5,454-vertex multi-label counterexample to Seymour-Sullivan Conjecture 6.1 and prototype optimality
field: directed graphs, rainbow paths, and combinatorial optimization
decided_scope: positive-length reachability, unordered injective label sequences, overlapping multi-label arc palettes (5,454 vertices, 11,792,572 arcs, minimum deficit 1), and exact LP/ILP optimality of 5,454 vertices on the 16-vertex prototype
open_boundaries: minimum vertex count across arbitrary templates
